description: The decider member of a v1.0 record (Record §6): the writer's refusals, finalized-block references, the consistency of kind, scheme and agent reference, agreement with the signature expectation, the material a capture presents, the reader's decider row (Verification §4.9), and identifier commitments.
source: Generated by scripts/generate-decider-vectors.ts. Every expected answer is written in the script from the specification, and the script stops if the engine disagrees with one. A writer tries its rules in this order: shape (not_an_object, unknown_members, missing_members), kind, identifier, agent reference, credential reference, freshness reference, agent presence (agent_reference_forbidden, agent_reference_required), scheme, desc value. Each shapes case breaks one rule; the consistency grid breaks several and pins the order. WebAuthn signatures here are placeholders: the checks read which challenge an assertion presents.
